#### SE-S-020 – Supply Plan

**Business Intent**
Provide exactly one authoritative supply planning baseline for a Planning Scope and horizon, so downstream supply capabilities work from the same governed interpretation of how demand will be satisfied.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Supply Plan is the aggregate root that maintains the authoritative version series of supply plans for a defined Planning Scope and horizon. Each plan version represents the enterprise's current planning baseline for supply execution — specifying planned production, procurement, transfers, projected inventory, projected shortfall, constraint status, and planning assumptions. It is the enterprise's authoritative, feasible, and balanced plan of how it intends to satisfy demand across the supply network, respecting constraints and balancing service, cost, and risk. All downstream supply capabilities consume this baseline rather than independently determining supply requirements.

**Identity**
Planning Scope + Plan Horizon. Each plan version receives a globally unique Supply Plan Version Identifier and a monotonically increasing Version Number within the aggregate.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Plan Supply (CA-S-002) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The authoritative, versioned supply planning baseline for a Planning Scope and horizon. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Produce and publish the enterprise's authoritative supply plan. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per Planning Scope and horizon. Exactly one Published version is authoritative at any moment. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Manage Inventory (projected inventory positions), Manage Capacity (resource utilization), Procure Materials (planned procurement quantities), Schedule Production (planned production quantities), Manage Distribution (planned transfers), Promise Intelligence (ATP/CTP evaluation), Scenario Intelligence (baseline for scenario comparison). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous Published version within the same Planning Scope and horizon. |
| **Superseded By** | A newer Published version within the same Planning Scope and horizon. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | Every Published plan satisfies all hard constraints or documents approved constraint relaxations. The plan covers the full planning horizon for all mandatory item-location combinations. All published plans are immutable and permanently retained. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers must treat the Published Supply Plan as the single authoritative planning baseline. Downstream capabilities derive their specific plans from it; they do not independently determine supply requirements. |
| **Known Limitations** | The plan is a planning baseline, not an execution guarantee. It reflects the assumptions and constraints in effect at the time of generation. |
| **Version Expectations** | A new version is produced each planning cycle. The previous Published version is superseded. All versions are retained permanently for audit and plan-accuracy measurement. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | The plan is refreshed on the defined planning cadence. Staleness is governed by the planning cycle. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Manage Inventory, Manage Capacity, Procure Materials, Schedule Production, Manage Distribution, Promise Intelligence, Scenario Intelligence. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

**Version Lifecycle**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger | Responsible Behaviour |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Draft | Plan created, all quantities and projections populated. | Supply-demand balancing completes; a new draft plan is produced. | AB-S-010 |
| Published | Plan version released as authoritative. | Plan accepted by DE-S-011 and publication authorised by DE-S-012. | AB-S-012 |
| Superseded | Replaced by a newer Published plan version. | A newer plan version is Published for the same Planning Scope. | AB-S-012 |


- **Terminal States:** Superseded (version retained permanently for audit; no further state changes).
- **History Preservation:** All published plans retained permanently.
- **Versioning Rules:** Each version receives a monotonically increasing Version Number within the aggregate. Version numbers are scoped to the Planning Scope and never reset.

**Information Model**

**Observation:** SE-S-020’s Information Model does not explicitly mark attributes as mandatory, optional, or derived.

**Action:** Add a “Type” column to the Information Model table in SE-S-020, following the pattern used in SE-S-010:


| Category | Information | Type | Description |
|----------|-------------|------|-------------|
| Identity | Planning Scope | Mandatory | The Planning Scope (SE-C-010) that defines the business boundary for this plan. |
| Identity | Plan Horizon | Mandatory | The Planning Horizon (SE-C-027) defining the temporal extent. |
| Identity | Supply Plan Version Identifier | Mandatory | Globally unique identity for this plan version. |
| Identity | Version Number | Mandatory | Monotonically increasing version number within the Planning Scope. |
| Identity | Lifecycle State | Mandatory | Draft, Published, or Superseded. |
| Configuration | Time Bucket configuration | Mandatory | The time granularity (daily, weekly) of planned quantities. |
| Planned Supply | Planned Production Quantities | Derived | Production the enterprise intends to execute, per Item (SE-C-001), Physical Resource (SE-C-007), Location (SE-C-002), and time bucket. |
| Planned Supply | Planned Procurement Quantities | Derived | Purchases the enterprise intends to make, per Item (SE-C-001), Supplier (SE-C-004), and time bucket. |
| Planned Supply | Planned Transfer Quantities | Derived | Internal movements the enterprise intends to execute, per Item (SE-C-001), source Location (SE-C-002), destination Location (SE-C-002), and time bucket. |
| Projected State | Projected Inventory | Derived | Expected on-hand inventory after all planned supply and demand consumption. Provides the planning baseline for Inventory Management. |
| Projected State | Projected Shortfall | Derived | Demand expected to remain unsatisfied after all feasible supply has been planned. Serves as enterprise input for Promise Intelligence, Scenario Intelligence, and planner intervention. |
| Supply-Demand Balance | Satisfied Demand | Derived | Demand fully satisfied by the plan. |
| Supply-Demand Balance | Delayed Demand | Derived | Demand that cannot be satisfied on time but can be satisfied later. |
| Supply-Demand Balance | Unmet Demand | Derived | Demand that cannot be satisfied at all within the plan horizon. |
| Supply-Demand Balance | Excess Supply | Derived | Supply that exceeds demand and remains unused. |
| Constraint Status | Resource Utilization vs. Capacity | Derived | Per-resource, per-time-bucket utilization against Available Capacity. |
| Constraint Status | Constraint Status | Derived | Classification per resource and time bucket: Feasible, Near Capacity, Overloaded. |
| Constraint Status | Documented Constraint Relaxations | Derived | Approved relaxations of hard constraints per PO-S-021. |
| Planning Assumptions | Supplier lead time assumptions | Optional | Assumptions accepted during plan generation regarding supplier lead times. |
| Planning Assumptions | Capacity availability assumptions | Optional | Assumptions regarding resource capacity availability. |
| Planning Assumptions | Sourcing assumptions | Optional | Assumptions regarding which sources are available for procurement. |
| Planning Assumptions | Inventory assumptions | Optional | Assumptions regarding inventory availability and policy. |
| Planning Assumptions | Demand assumptions | Optional | Demand assumptions inherited from Demand Intelligence. |
| Supporting Assessment | Plan Confidence Score | Derived | Overall confidence in the plan, derived from data quality, supplier reliability, capacity certainty, and constraint satisfaction. |
| Traceability | Transaction Time | Mandatory | When the plan version was created. |
| Traceability | Publication Time | Mandatory | When the plan version was published (absent for Draft). |
| Traceability | Superseded Plan Identifier | Mandatory | The identifier of the previously Published version that this plan supersedes. |
| Traceability | Source Demand Reference | Mandatory | Reference to the Demand Forecast (SE-C-013) used for generation. |
| Traceability | Source Supply Reference | Mandatory | Reference to the Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) used as planning baseline. |


**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| is plan for | Planning Scope (SE-C-010) | Many-to-One | Each plan version covers exactly one Planning Scope. |
| references planning horizon | Planning Horizon (SE-C-027) | Many-to-One | The temporal extent of the plan. |
| satisfies demand | Demand (SE-C-013) | One-to-Many | The demand requirements the plan addresses. |
| plans production on | Physical Resource (SE-C-007) | Many-to-Many | Resources assigned for production. |
| plans procurement from | Supplier (SE-C-004) | Many-to-Many | Suppliers for planned procurement. |
| moves items between | Location (SE-C-002) | Many-to-Many | Source and destination locations for transfers. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Semantic Dependency | Planning Scope (SE-C-010), Planning Horizon (SE-C-027), Item (SE-C-001), Location (SE-C-002), Physical Resource (SE-C-007), Supplier (SE-C-004), Demand (SE-C-013), Calendar (SE-C-033) for time bucket configuration. |
| Supply Domain Dependency | Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) as planning baseline. |
| Conceptual Dependency | Planning Parameters and Planning Calendars from Master Data / Planning Governance. |

*Note:  “`SE-S-020` is a domain-specific specialization of the enterprise concept `SE-C-012 Plan`. It inherits the planning scope, horizon, and scenario references, and adds supply-specific planned quantities and constraints.” This prevents semantic duplication confusion.*

**Invariants**
- Exactly one Published Supply Plan exists for a given Planning Scope at any moment.
- A Published plan is immutable. Any change requires a new plan produced by a new planning run.
- All hard constraints must be satisfied or documented and approved as constraint relaxations.
- The plan must cover the full planning horizon for all mandatory item-location combinations.

**Traceability**
- **Business Owner:** CA-S-002.
- **Produced By:** AB-S-010–012.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-010–012.
- **Governed By:** BR-S-020–029.
- **Upward:** Constitution CN-003, CN-004; ARS §3, §4, §16.

#### AB-S-010 — Generate Supply Plan

**Purpose**
Execute the supply planning logic to produce a Draft Supply Plan with all planned quantities, projected inventory, constraint status, and supply-demand balance.

**Business Intent**
Produce a feasible draft supply plan that represents the enterprise's best understanding of how demand will be satisfied.

**Trigger**
Scheduled (weekly operational, monthly tactical) or event-driven (demand update, major disruption).

**Preconditions**
Demand forecast (Demand SE-C-013) and Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) available. Capacity and BOM data current. Planning Parameters defined.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- Planning Scope (SE-C-010) is active.
- Item (SE-C-001) and Location (SE-C-002) master data is complete.
- Physical Resource (SE-C-007) definitions and capacities are current.
- Supplier (SE-C-004) master data is available.
- Bill of Materials (SE-C-018) versions are active.

**Business Behaviour**
Balance supply and demand: match demand with available supply, respecting constraints. Populate planned production, planned procurement, planned transfer quantities, projected inventory, projected backorders, constraint status, and supply-demand balance. Compute plan confidence score.

**State Transitions**
- **Required Input State:** None (creation).
- **Produced Output State:** Draft.

**Business Transaction**
Protects Supply Plan aggregate. Atomic creation of all planned quantities and projections.

**Decisions Invoked**
None (solver selection is governed by policy, not a business decision).

**Rules Enforced**
All hard constraints as defined in the Supply Planning Policy.

**Policies Referenced**
Supply Planning Policy (governing constraint relaxation and solver configuration).

**Algorithms Invoked**
BA-S-015 (Balance Supply and Demand)

**Events Published**
EV-S-010 (Supply Plan Generated).

**Notifications Produced**
None.

**Idempotency**
Re-execution with the same inputs produces an identical plan (deterministic).

**Concurrency**
Generation for a given Planning Scope is serialized.

**Exceptional Conditions**
If the supply-demand balance cannot be fully resolved due to infeasibility, the Draft plan records the unresolved constraints and projections. The plan is not discarded.

**Postconditions**
A Draft Supply Plan exists with all planned quantities and projections populated. EV-S-010 published. Eligible for evaluation (AB-S-011).

**Traceability**
Owned by SE-S-020. Invoked by FS-S-010.

---

#### AB-S-011 — Evaluate Supply Plan

**Purpose**
Assess the Draft Supply Plan against business quality KPIs and stability rules.

**Business Intent**
Ensure the draft plan meets enterprise planning objectives before publication.

**Trigger**
Completion of AB-S-010 (Draft Supply Plan exists).

**Preconditions**
Draft Supply Plan exists.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- The Draft Supply Plan contains all mandatory outputs from AB-S-010.
- Quality thresholds (service level, capacity utilization, inventory policy, cost) are governed by the Supply Planning Policy.

**Business Behaviour**
Evaluate the draft plan against service level targets, capacity utilization maxima, projected inventory within policy bounds, and total cost within budget variance. Assess plan stability within the frozen period.

**State Transitions**
- **Required Input State:** Draft.
- **Produced Output State:** Draft (evaluated; acceptance decision recorded).

**Business Transaction**
Protects Supply Plan aggregate. Evaluation result recorded atomically.

**Decisions Invoked**
DE-S-011 (Accept Supply Plan).

**Rules Enforced**
BR-S-025 (Quality Thresholds), BR-S-026 (Plan Stability).

**Policies Referenced**
PO-S-022 (Supply Plan Acceptance Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked**
None.

**Events Published**
EV-S-011 (Supply Plan Evaluated).

**Notifications Produced**
None.

**Idempotency**
Re-evaluation produces the same outcome.

**Concurrency**
Evaluation for a given plan version occurs once.

**Exceptional Conditions**
If any mandatory quality threshold fails, the plan is rejected and must be re-planned or escalated per PO-S-021.

**Postconditions**
Plan is evaluated and recorded as accepted or rejected. EV-S-011 published. If accepted, eligible for publication (AB-S-012).

**Traceability**
Owned by SE-S-020. Invoked by FS-S-011.

---

#### AB-S-012 — Publish Supply Plan

**Purpose**
Publish the accepted Supply Plan, making it authoritative for downstream execution.

**Business Intent**
Establish the accepted plan as the enterprise's authoritative supply planning baseline for all downstream capabilities.

**Trigger**
Completion of AB-S-011 with accepted plan.

**Preconditions**
Plan accepted by DE-S-011.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- The accepted Draft Supply Plan satisfies all quality thresholds and stability rules.
- All downstream capabilities are prepared to consume the new plan.

**Business Behaviour**
Execute DE-S-012 (Publish Supply Plan). If Publish, transition Draft to Published, record Publication Time, supersede previous Published version, publish BN-S-010.

**State Transitions**
- **Required Input State:** Draft (accepted).
- **Produced Output State:** Published. Previous Published version → Superseded.

**Business Transaction**
Protects Supply Plan aggregate. Atomic publication and previous version superseding.

**Decisions Invoked**
DE-S-012 (Publish Supply Plan).

**Rules Enforced**
BR-S-027 (Plan Must Be Accepted), BR-S-028 (Unique Versioning).

**Policies Referenced**
PO-S-023 (Supply Plan Publication Cadence).

**Algorithms Invoked**
None.

**Events Published**
EV-S-012 (Supply Plan Published).

**Notifications Produced**
BN-S-010 (Supply Plan Published).

**Idempotency**
Re-execution on already-published version terminates immediately.

**Concurrency**
Publication for a given version occurs exactly once.

**Exceptional Conditions**
None. The plan has already passed evaluation.

**Postconditions**
Exactly one Published Supply Plan exists for the Planning Scope. BN-S-010 published. All downstream capabilities receive the new baseline.

**Traceability**
Owned by SE-S-020. Invoked by FS-S-012. Publishes BN-S-010.

#### SE-S-030 – Inventory Position Assessment

**Business Intent**
Provide a continuously current enterprise interpretation of what each active item-location inventory position means for service, risk, financial exposure, and policy compliance.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Inventory Position Assessment is the aggregate root that maintains the current inventory position assessment for one active item-location. It interprets current and projected inventory—including coverage, risk, financial exposure, and policy compliance—and preserves an immutable assessment change history. It transforms raw inventory data into interpreted enterprise understanding that downstream capabilities can rely upon.

**Identity**
Item (SE-C-001) + Location (SE-C-002). One assessment per active item-location.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Manage Inventory (CA-S-003) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The continuously maintained interpretation of inventory position for an active item-location. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Interpret current and projected inventory; assess coverage, risk, financial exposure, and policy compliance. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per active item-location. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous assessment state for the same item-location (via Assessment Change Events). |
| **Superseded By** | A newer assessment for the same item-location. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | At any moment, an active item-location has exactly one current Inventory Position Assessment. The assessment is derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) and Supply Plan (SE-S-020) available at evaluation time. Assessment Change Events are immutable. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the assessment as the authoritative interpretation of current inventory risk, coverage, and policy compliance. It does not prescribe replenishment actions; those are determined by downstream capabilities. |
| **Known Limitations** | The assessment is a point-in-time interpretation based on the best available evidence. It does not replace the underlying inventory data. It may be updated as new evidence arrives. |
| **Version Expectations** | Continuously maintained; not versioned. Previous assessment values are retained as immutable change events. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated upon publication of the Supply Understanding, Supply Plan, or on a governed re-evaluation schedule. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| Active | Item-location is actively assessed. Current interpretation and change history are maintained. | AB-S-020 (Update) |
| Archived | Item-location is no longer active for planning. Final state retained for audit; no new assessment changes appended. | Archive operation |


- **Terminal States:** Archived.
- **History Preservation:** All assessment states and Assessment Change Events are retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Category | Information | Type | Description |
|----------|-------------|------|-------------|
| Identity | Item (SE-C-001), Location (SE-C-002) | Mandatory | The item-location being assessed. |
| Current Position | On-hand, allocated, backorder, available quantity | Derived | Current inventory position derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001). |
| Projected Position | Projected inventory, projected stockout period, projected excess | Derived | Future inventory interpretation derived from the latest published Supply Plan (SE-S-020). |
| Interpretation | Days of Supply, coverage status, risk level, health status, financial exposure | Derived | Business interpretation used by downstream capabilities. |
| Governance | Policy compliance status, policy reference | Derived | Relationship to current Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031). |
| Traceability | Source Supply Understanding ID, Source Supply Plan ID, assessment timestamp | Mandatory | Evidence used to produce the assessment. |
| History | Assessment Change Events | Derived | Immutable record of assessment changes. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| assesses stock of | Item (SE-C-001) | Many-to-One | The item being assessed. |
| is held at | Location (SE-C-002) | Many-to-One | The location where the stock is held. |
| derived from supply understanding | Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) | Many-to-One | Source of current inventory position data. |
| derived from supply plan | Supply Plan (SE-S-020) | Many-to-One | Source of projected inventory data. |
| governed by policy | Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031) | Many-to-One | Current replenishment policy for this item-location. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Semantic Dependency | Item (SE-C-001), Location (SE-C-002). |
| Supply Domain Dependency | Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020), Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031). |

**Invariants**
- At any moment, an active item-location has exactly one current Inventory Position Assessment.
- The assessment is derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) and Supply Plan (SE-S-020) available at evaluation time.
- Assessment Change Events are immutable.

#### AB-S-020 — Update Inventory Position Assessment

**Purpose** Re-evaluate and update the Inventory Position Assessment for an item-location based on the latest Supply Understanding and Supply Plan.

**Business Intent** Maintain a continuously current enterprise interpretation of inventory position by reflecting the latest supply evidence.

**Trigger** Supply Understanding published (BN-S-001), Supply Plan published (BN-S-010), or scheduled re-evaluation.

**Preconditions** Latest Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) and Supply Plan (SE-S-020) are available. The item-location is active for planning.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- Item (SE-C-001) and Location (SE-C-002) exist and are active.
- Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) has a Published version with current inventory position data for this item-location.
- Supply Plan (SE-S-020) has a Published version with projected inventory data for this item-location.
- Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031) exists for this item-location.

**Business Behaviour**
Re-evaluate the current and projected inventory position. Determine Days of Supply, coverage status, risk level, health status, financial exposure, and policy compliance. If the assessment has materially changed from the previous state, append an Assessment Change Event with the reason and evidence (e.g., “Supply Plan v14 projected stockout for Item A at DC-West, moving health status from Normal to At Risk”).

**State Transitions**
- Required Input State: Active.
- Produced Output State: Active (health status, risk levels, coverage may change; Assessment Change Event appended if a material change occurred).

**Business Transaction** Protects Inventory Position Assessment aggregate. Atomic update of current interpretation and change history.

**Decisions Invoked** DE-S-021 (Determine Inventory Position Status).

**Rules Enforced** BR-S-040 (Coverage Thresholds), BR-S-041 (Risk Assessment Criteria), BR-S-042 (Obsolescence Criteria).

**Policies Referenced** PO-S-032 (Inventory Health Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked** BA-S-004 (Evaluate Inventory Risk — deferred).

**Events Published** EV-S-020 (Inventory Position Assessment Changed).

**Notifications Produced** BN-S-020 (Inventory Position Assessment Changed) — published if health status or risk level changed.

**Idempotency** Re-evaluation with the same inputs produces the same result.

**Concurrency** Assessments for different item-locations are processed independently.

**Exceptional Conditions** None. The assessment is always updated to reflect the latest available evidence. If source data is missing, the assessment is deferred and the previous interpretation remains.

**Postconditions** The Inventory Position Assessment reflects the latest enterprise understanding. BN-S-020 published if a material change occurred.

**Traceability** Owned by SE-S-030. Invoked by FS-S-020. Publishes BN-S-020.

#### SE-S-031 – Inventory Policy Assignment

**Business Intent**
Ensure every active item-location has exactly one current, governed inventory policy that downstream replenishment decisions can rely on.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Inventory Policy Assignment is the aggregate root that maintains the current inventory policy assignment for one active item-location, including policy type, safety stock, reorder point, lot size, review period, service target, and immutable policy change history.

**Identity**
Item (SE-C-001) + Location (SE-C-002). One assignment per active item-location.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Manage Inventory (CA-S-003) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The current governed replenishment policy for an item-location. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Maintain the governed policy parameters and track all policy changes. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per active item-location. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous policy assignment for the same item-location (via Policy Change Events). |
| **Superseded By** | A newer policy assignment for the same item-location. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | At any moment, an active item-location has exactly one current Inventory Policy Assignment. Policy Change Events are immutable. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall use the policy parameters to drive replenishment calculations. Planner overrides require justification and are subject to periodic review. |
| **Known Limitations** | The policy is a governed target; actual replenishment actions may deviate based on operational constraints. |
| **Version Expectations** | Continuously maintained; not versioned. Previous policy values are retained as immutable change events. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated upon Supply Plan publication, demand forecast updates, or governed re-calculation schedule. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |

#### AB-S-021 — Update Inventory Policy

**Purpose:** Recalculate and update the inventory policy parameters for an item-location according to the Inventory Policy Governance.

**Business Intent:** Ensure the governed replenishment parameters reflect the latest demand and supply conditions.

**Trigger:** Supply Plan published (BN-S-010), demand forecast updated, or governed re-calculation schedule.

**Preconditions:** Demand and supply data are available. Inventory Policy Governance is current.

- Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) is published.

**Business Behaviour:** Recalculate safety stock, reorder point, lot size, review period, and service level target according to the Inventory Policy Governance. If the policy has changed, append a Policy Change Event with the new values and justification.

- Required Input State: Active.
- Produced Output State: Active (policy parameters may change; Policy Change Event appended).

**Notifications Produced:** BN-S-021 (Inventory Policy Updated).

#### SE-S-032 – Inventory Health Assessment

**Business Intent**
Provide a periodic, authoritative management view of inventory health for a defined scope and evaluation period.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Inventory Health Assessment is the aggregate root that maintains the published inventory health assessment version series for an assessment scope and evaluation period. Each version contains health classifications per item-location, aggregated risk and financial summaries, and references to the source assessments used as evidence. It is the enterprise’s periodic, governed statement of inventory health for management oversight, trend analysis, and supply quality evaluation, not an operational dashboard.

**Identity**
Assessment Scope + Evaluation Period. Each assessment version receives a globally unique Assessment Version Identifier and a monotonically increasing Version Number within the aggregate.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Manage Inventory (CA-S-003) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The periodic, versioned inventory health assessment for a defined scope and period. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Publish authoritative health classifications, risk summaries, and financial summaries for management oversight. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per Assessment Scope and Evaluation Period. Exactly one Published version is authoritative for the scope and period. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials (use over-stocked signals for deferral), Evaluate Supply Quality (track health trends), Learn From Supply (identify policy improvement opportunities), Management (dashboards). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous Published version for the same scope and period. |
| **Superseded By** | A newer Published version for the same scope and period. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | Exactly one Published Inventory Health Assessment exists for a given scope and evaluation period. A Published assessment is immutable. Every classification references the source Inventory Position Assessment and Inventory Policy Assignment evidence used. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the assessment as the authoritative management view of inventory health for the period. It is a periodic snapshot, not a continuously updated operational view. |
| **Known Limitations** | The assessment is a point-in-time snapshot based on the best available evidence at the time of publication. It does not replace the underlying operational inventory data. |
| **Version Expectations** | Published on a governed schedule. Previous versions are superseded and retained permanently for trend analysis. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Published on the cadence defined by the Inventory Health Policy (PO-S-034). |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply, Management. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procure Materials, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply, Management. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

**Version Lifecycle**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| Draft | Assessment computed for the evaluation period. Health classification, risk summary, and financial summary populated. | AB-S-022 (Publish Inventory Health Assessment) |
| Published | Assessment version released as authoritative for the scope and period. | Publication |
| Superseded | Version replaced by a newer Published version. | Newer version Published |


- **Terminal States:** Superseded (retained permanently; no further state changes).
- **History Preservation:** All published assessments retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Health Classification | Optimal, Under-Stocked, Over-Stocked, At Risk, Obsolete | Derived | Classification per item-location. |
| Risk Summary | Stockout risk, excess risk, obsolescence risk, supplier risk | Derived | Aggregated risk interpretation. |
| Financial Summary | Inventory value, excess exposure, shortage exposure | Derived | Financial interpretation. |
| Evidence | Source Inventory Position Assessment IDs, Source Inventory Policy Assignment IDs | Mandatory | Evidence used. |
| Traceability | Publication Time, Superseded Version ID | Mandatory | Timestamps and version lineage. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| evaluates health for scope | Assessment Scope (defined by domain) | Many-to-One | The set of item-locations evaluated. |
| references position assessments | Inventory Position Assessment (SE-S-030) | One-to-Many | Source assessments. |
| references policy assignments | Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031) | One-to-Many | Source policies. |

**Dependencies** Inventory Position Assessment (SE-S-030), Inventory Policy Assignment (SE-S-031).

**Invariants**
- Exactly one Published Inventory Health Assessment exists for a given scope and evaluation period.
- A Published Health Assessment is immutable.
- Every classification references the Inventory Position Assessment and Inventory Policy Assignment evidence used.

**Traceability**

- **Produced By:** AB-S-022.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-022.

#### AB-S-022 — Publish Inventory Health Assessment

**Purpose:** Compute inventory health classifications for all covered item-locations and publish the periodic, versioned assessment.

**Business Intent:** Provide the authoritative periodic management view of inventory health.

**Trigger:** Scheduled per Inventory Health Policy (PO-S-034). May also be triggered on demand for governance review.

**Preconditions:** Latest Inventory Position Assessments (SE-S-030) and Inventory Policy Assignments (SE-S-031) are available for all item-locations in the assessment scope.

**Semantic Preconditions:**
- Inventory Position Assessments (SE-S-030) are current for all item-locations in the defined scope.
- Inventory Policy Assignments (SE-S-031) are current for all item-locations in the defined scope.

**Business Behaviour:** For each item-location in the assessment scope, classify health status as Optimal, Under-Stocked, Over-Stocked, At Risk, or Obsolete according to the governed thresholds in the Inventory Health Policy. Aggregate risk summaries (stockout, excess, obsolescence, supplier) and financial summaries (inventory value, excess exposure, shortage exposure). Compose the assessment version and publish.

**State Transitions:**
- Required Input State: None (creation) or Draft.
- Produced Output State: Published (previous Published version for the same scope and period → Superseded).

**Business Transaction:** Protects Inventory Health Assessment aggregate. Atomic publication and previous version superseding.

**Decisions Invoked:** DE-S-023 (Classify Inventory Health).

**Rules Enforced:** BR-S-049 (Health Classification Thresholds).

**Policies Referenced:** PO-S-034 (Inventory Health Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked:** BA-S-005 (Classify Inventory Health — deferred).

**Events Published:** EV-S-022 (Inventory Health Assessment Published).

**Notifications Produced:** BN-S-022 (Inventory Health Assessment Published).

**Idempotency:** Re-assessment for the same scope and evaluation period produces the same results.

**Concurrency:** Assessments for different scopes are independent.

**Exceptional Conditions:** If source assessments are missing for any item-location, that location is flagged as “Unassessed” with a reason code, and the assessment proceeds with the available data.

**Postconditions:** A Published Inventory Health Assessment exists for the scope and period. BN-S-022 published.

**Traceability:** Owned by SE-S-032. Invoked by FS-S-022. Publishes BN-S-022.

#### SE-S-040 – Capacity Position Assessment

**Business Intent**
Provide a continuously current enterprise interpretation of resource capacity adequacy, constraint status, bottleneck risk, flexibility, and confidence for every constrained resource.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Capacity Position Assessment is the aggregate root that maintains the current capacity position assessment for one active resource. It interprets Available Capacity (installed capacity less planned downtime and maintenance) against Planned Load (production orders, planned production, maintenance, and reserved capacity) over the time buckets defined by the Planning Calendar. It records how the enterprise arrived at its understanding (explainability) and accommodates both current-state interpretation and future predictive signals (emerging bottleneck, predicted overload). The assessment is continuously maintained; as new evidence arrives, the interpretation is updated and the change history is preserved.

**Identity**
Physical Resource (SE-C-007). One assessment per active resource.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Manage Capacity (CA-S-004) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The continuously maintained interpretation of capacity position for a resource. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Interpret current and projected capacity utilization; identify constraints, bottlenecks, risks, flexibility, and load composition. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per active resource. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply (operational constraint feedback), Schedule Production (resource availability and flexibility), Evaluate Supply Quality (capacity effectiveness). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous assessment state for the same resource (via Assessment Change Events). |
| **Superseded By** | A newer assessment for the same resource (when updated). |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | At any moment, an active resource has exactly one current Capacity Position Assessment. The assessment is derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020), and resource calendars (Calendar SE-C-033) available at evaluation time. Assessment Change Events are immutable and record the reason and evidence for each change. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the assessment as the authoritative interpretation of current and projected capacity position. Constraint and bottleneck are distinct concepts; the assessment separates them. The assessment does not prescribe scheduling actions; those are determined by downstream capabilities. |
| **Known Limitations** | The assessment is a point-in-time interpretation. It does not replace the underlying resource data or calendars. It may be updated as new evidence arrives. |
| **Version Expectations** | Continuously maintained; not versioned. Previous assessment states are retained as immutable change events. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated upon publication of the Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020), resource calendar changes, or on a governed re-evaluation schedule. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply, Schedule Production, Evaluate Supply Quality. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| Active | Resource is actively assessed. Current interpretation and change history maintained. | AB-S-030 (Update) |
| Archived | Resource is no longer active for planning. Final state retained for audit; no new assessment changes appended. | Archive operation |

- **Terminal States:** Archived.
- **History Preservation:** All assessment states and Assessment Change Events are retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Category | Information | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| Identity | Physical Resource (SE-C-007) | The constrained resource being assessed. |
| Current Position | Available Capacity (installed capacity less planned downtime/maintenance), Current Utilization, Current Load | Derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) and resource calendars (shift, working, maintenance, holiday) from Calendar (SE-C-033). |
| Projected Position | Projected Load, Projected Utilization, Projected Overload Periods, Projected Underload Periods, Constraint Horizon (when constraints exist) | Derived from the latest published Supply Plan (SE-S-020). Time-phased across the planning buckets (daily, weekly, monthly). |
| Load Composition | Production Orders, Planned Production, Maintenance, Reserved Capacity | What is consuming capacity. Enriches explainability. |
| Interpretation | Utilization Status (Feasible, Near Capacity, Overloaded, Underutilized) per time bucket, Constraint Status (per-period load vs. capacity), Bottleneck Assessment (whether the resource constrains overall system throughput) | Business interpretation. Constraint and bottleneck are distinct concepts. |
| Flexibility | Alternate Resources, Overtime Feasibility, Subcontracting Options, Extra Shift Feasibility, Cross-Trained Labor, Resource Substitutability | Capacity flexibility interpretation. |
| Risk | Overload Risk, Underload Risk, Bottleneck Risk, Single Point of Failure Risk, Maintenance Dependency Risk, Labor Availability Risk | Structured risk assessment. Risk is a first-class dimension. |
| Confidence | Assessment Confidence (influenced by missing resource calendars, estimated routing times, uncertain labor availability, incomplete maintenance plans) | Placeholder for future confidence modelling. |
| Traceability | Source Supply Understanding ID, Source Supply Plan ID, assessment timestamp | Evidence used to produce the assessment. |
| History | Assessment Change Events (each records the reason and evidence for the change, e.g., “Supply Plan v14 added 200 hours of production load to WC-100, moving it from Feasible to Overloaded”) | Immutable record of assessment changes with explainability. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| evaluates capacity of | Physical Resource (SE-C-007) | Many-to-One | The resource being assessed. |
| derived from supply understanding | Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) | Many-to-One | Current capacity and utilization data. |
| derived from supply plan | Supply Plan (SE-S-020) | Many-to-One | Projected production load data. |
| uses calendar | Calendar (SE-C-033) | Many-to-One | Working time definition for the resource. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Semantic Dependency | Physical Resource (SE-C-007), Calendar (SE-C-033). |
| Supply Domain Dependency | Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020). |

**Invariants**
- At any moment, an active resource has exactly one current Capacity Position Assessment.
- The assessment is derived from the latest published Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020), and resource calendars (Calendar SE-C-033) available at evaluation time.
- Assessment Change Events are immutable.

**Traceability**
- **Business Owner:** CA-S-004.
- **Produced By:** AB-S-030.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-030.
- **Governed By:** BR-S-060–065 and PO-S-050.
- **Upward:** Constitution CN-003, CN-004; ARS §3, §4, §16.

#### AB-S-030 — Update Capacity Position Assessment

**Purpose**
Re-evaluate and update the Capacity Position Assessment for a resource based on the latest Supply Understanding, Supply Plan, and resource calendars.

**Business Intent**
Maintain a continuously current enterprise interpretation of capacity position by reflecting the latest supply and planning evidence.

**Trigger**
Supply Understanding published (BN-S-001), Supply Plan published (BN-S-010), resource calendar updated, or scheduled re-evaluation.

**Preconditions**
Latest Supply Understanding (SE-S-001), Supply Plan (SE-S-020), and resource calendars (Calendar SE-C-033) are available. The resource is active for planning.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- Physical Resource (SE-C-007) is active.
- Calendar (SE-C-033) for the resource is current.
- Supply Understanding (SE-S-001) has a Published version with current capacity and utilization data.
- Supply Plan (SE-S-020) has a Published version with projected production load data.

**Business Behaviour**
Re-evaluate available capacity, projected load, utilization status, constraint classification, bottleneck assessment, risk levels, flexibility, and load composition. If any of these have materially changed from the previous assessment, append an Assessment Change Event with the reason and evidence (e.g., “Supply Plan v14 added 200 hours of production load to WC-100, moving it from Feasible to Overloaded”).

**State Transitions**
- **Required Input State:** Active.
- **Produced Output State:** Active (utilization status, constraint classification, bottleneck assessment, risk levels, flexibility interpretation may change; Assessment Change Event appended if a material change occurred).

**Business Transaction**
Protects Capacity Position Assessment aggregate. Atomic update of current interpretation and change history.

**Decisions Invoked**
DE-S-031 (Determine Capacity Position Status).

**Rules Enforced**
BR-S-060 (Utilization Thresholds), BR-S-061 (Constraint Classification), BR-S-062 (Bottleneck Criteria), BR-S-063 (Flexibility Assessment Rules), BR-S-064 (Risk Assessment Criteria).

**Policies Referenced**
PO-S-050 (Capacity Management Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked**
BA-S-010 (Evaluate Capacity Risk — deferred).

**Events Published**
EV-S-030 (Capacity Position Assessment Changed).

**Notifications Produced**
BN-S-030 (Capacity Position Assessment Changed) — published if utilization status, constraint, bottleneck, flexibility, or risk changed.

**Idempotency**
Re-evaluation with the same inputs produces the same result.

**Concurrency**
Assessments for different resources are processed independently.

**Exceptional Conditions**
If source data (Supply Understanding, Supply Plan, or calendar) is missing for this resource, the assessment is deferred and the previous interpretation remains; the resource is flagged “Unassessed” with a reason code.

**Postconditions**
The Capacity Position Assessment reflects the latest enterprise understanding. BN-S-030 published if a material change occurred.

**Traceability**
Owned by SE-S-040. Invoked by FS-S-030. Publishes BN-S-030.

#### SE-S-050 – Supplier Commitment

**Business Intent:** Maintain the authoritative enterprise record of a planning collaboration agreement between the enterprise and a specific supplier for a specific supply requirement—capturing both the enterprise’s request and the supplier’s response, together with any alternative proposals, assumptions, and confidence.

**Enterprise Meaning:**
The Supplier Commitment is the aggregate root that maintains the complete bidirectional collaboration record for one supply requirement. It tracks the enterprise’s request, the supplier’s response (including commitment state, committed quantities/dates, and alternatives), the confidence the enterprise places in that commitment, any supplier-declared assumptions, and the immutable collaboration history showing the full conversation.

**Identity:** Supplier (SE-C-004) + Item (SE-C-001) + Required Date. The identity model is intentionally extensible: future versions may incorporate ship-to location, planning scope, purchase organization, or delivery window if needed without changing the core design.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Collaborate with Suppliers (CA-S-005) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The record of planning collaboration between the enterprise and a supplier for a supply requirement. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Track enterprise request and supplier response; maintain the collaboration history. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per supplier, item, and required date. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply, Procure Materials, Supplier Commitment Assessment (SE-S-051). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous commitment state for the same requirement (via Collaboration Events). |
| **Superseded By** | A newer commitment for the same requirement. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | Collaboration Events are immutable. Only the latest supplier response determines the current commitment state. A commitment is uniquely identified by Supplier, Item, and Required Date. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall use the commitment as the authoritative record of the supplier’s response. It does not define commercial terms beyond the commitment. |
| **Known Limitations** | Does not include delivery instructions, quality requirements, or commercial terms. |
| **Version Expectations** | Active while collaboration is ongoing; transitioned to Closed when fulfilled or cancelled. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated upon supplier response or enterprise decision. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply, Procure Materials, Supplier Commitment Assessment. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

**Collaboration Lifecycle**

| State | Meaning | Transition Trigger |
|-------|---------|-------------------|
| Proposed | Enterprise has communicated the requirement to the supplier; no response yet. | Enterprise proposal. |
| Acknowledged | Supplier has received the requirement; no commitment yet. | Supplier acknowledgment. |
| Committed | Supplier confirms full quantity by requested date. | Supplier response. |
| Partially Committed | Supplier commits partial quantity or alternate date. | Supplier response. |
| Rejected | Supplier cannot fulfil this requirement. | Supplier response. |
| Alternative Proposed | Supplier proposes a different quantity, date, product, or other alternative. | Supplier response. |
| Confirmed | Enterprise accepts the supplier’s commitment or alternative; commitment is now firm for planning. | Enterprise decision. |

**Permitted Transitions:** Proposed → Acknowledged → Committed / Partially Committed / Rejected / Alternative Proposed. Alternative Proposed → Confirmed (if enterprise accepts). Confirmed → (terminal for the current commitment; superseded by a new commitment if circumstances change).

- **Terminal States:** Committed (when fulfilled or closed), Rejected, Confirmed (when fulfilled or superseded).
- **History Preservation:** All Collaboration Events are retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Category | Information | Type | Description |
|----------|-------------|------|-------------|
| Identity | Supplier (SE-C-004) + Item (SE-C-001) + Required Date | Mandatory | Extensible to include location, planning scope, or delivery window. |
| Enterprise Request | Requested Quantity | Mandatory | The quantity requested by the enterprise. |
| Enterprise Request | Requested Date | Mandatory | The date by which the enterprise needs the item. |
| Enterprise Request | Request Timestamp | Mandatory | When the request was made. |
| Enterprise Request | Source Planning Reference | Optional | Reference to the Supply Plan (SE-S-020) that generated the requirement. |
| Supplier Response | Commitment State | Mandatory | Current state: Proposed, Acknowledged, Committed, Partially Committed, Rejected, Alternative Proposed, Confirmed. |
| Supplier Response | Committed Quantity | Optional | The quantity the supplier has committed to deliver (present in Committed, Partially Committed, Confirmed). |
| Supplier Response | Committed Date | Optional | The date the supplier has committed to deliver (present in Committed, Partially Committed, Confirmed). |
| Supplier Response | Response Timestamp | Mandatory | When the supplier’s response was received. |
| Commitment Confidence | Confidence Level | Optional | Firm, Conditional, Tentative, or Estimated. Based on historical reliability, responsiveness, and current signals. |
| Alternative Proposal | Description | Optional | Any alternative proposed by the supplier (alternate quantity, date, plant, route, etc.). |
| Supplier-Declared Assumptions | Assumptions | Optional | Free-text or structured list of assumptions the supplier is making. |
| Collaboration History | Collaboration Events | Derived | Chronological list of events (Enterprise Request, Supplier Response, Enterprise Decision) with timestamps and actors. |
| Traceability | Source Supply Plan ID | Optional | Evidence lineage. |
| Traceability | Last Updated Timestamp | Mandatory | When the record was last modified. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| involves item | Item (SE-C-001) | Many-to-One | The item being committed. |
| involves supplier | Supplier (SE-C-004) | Many-to-One | The supplier making the commitment. |
| references supply plan | Supply Plan (SE-S-020) | Many-to-One | The plan that generated the requirement. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Semantic Dependency | Item (SE-C-001), Supplier (SE-C-004). |
| Supply Domain Dependency | Supply Plan (SE-S-020). |

**Invariants**
- A commitment is uniquely identified by Supplier + Item + Required Date within the active collaboration scope.
- Collaboration Events are immutable.
- Only the latest supplier response determines the current commitment state.

**Traceability**
- **Business Owner:** CA-S-005.
- **Produced By:** AB-S-040.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-050.
- **Governed By:** BR-S-080–085 and PO-S-060.
- **Upward:** Constitution CN-003, CN-004; ARS §3, §4, §16.


#### AB-S-040 — Record Supplier Commitment

**Purpose:** Create or update a Supplier Commitment record following the enterprise’s proposal or the supplier’s response.

**Business Intent:** Maintain the authoritative collaborative record for a supply requirement.

**Trigger:** Supply Plan published, Inventory Position Assessment changed, or supplier response received.

**Preconditions:** Supply requirement identified; supplier known.

**Semantic Preconditions:**
- Item (SE-C-001) and Supplier (SE-C-004) exist and are active.
- Supply Plan (SE-S-020) identifies the requirement.
- If triggered by inventory changes, Inventory Position Assessment (SE-S-030) is current.

**Business Behaviour:** Record enterprise request or supplier response; update commitment state; append Collaboration Event.

**State Transitions:**
- Required Input State: None (creation) or Active.
- Produced Output State: Current commitment state updated; Collaboration Event appended.

**Business Transaction:** Protects Supplier Commitment aggregate. Atomic update.

**Decisions Invoked:** DE-S-041 (Accept Supplier Response).

**Rules Enforced:** BR-S-080 (Responsiveness thresholds), BR-S-081 (Historical reliability), BR-S-082 (Commitment confidence), BR-S-083 (Criticality of requirement).

**Policies Referenced:** PO-S-060 (Supplier Collaboration Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked:** BA-S-020 (Evaluate Commitment Confidence — deferred).

**Events Published:** EV-S-040 (Supplier Commitment Changed).

**Notifications Produced:** BN-S-040 (if commitment state or confidence changed).

**Idempotency:** Re-recording the same response with the same timestamp produces no duplicate event.

**Concurrency:** Commitments for different supplier-item-date combinations processed independently.

**Exceptional Conditions:** None beyond standard state transition rules.

**Postconditions:** Commitment state updated; BN-S-040 published if changed.

**Traceability:** Owned by SE-S-050. Invoked by FS-S-050. Publishes BN-S-040.

#### SE-S-051 – Supplier Commitment Assessment

**Business Intent:** Provide a continuously current enterprise interpretation of a supplier’s overall commitment posture, reliability, responsiveness, and risk—independent of individual commitments.

**Enterprise Meaning:** *(combined)*  
The Supplier Commitment Assessment is the aggregate root that maintains the current assessment of a supplier’s commitment posture—summarising open commitments, responsiveness, reliability, and current risk signals. The assessment is per supplier; the model is extensible to supplier × product if future enterprise needs require it.

**Identity:** Supplier (SE-C-004). One assessment per active supplier.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Collaborate with Suppliers (CA-S-005) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The continuously maintained interpretation of a supplier’s commitment posture. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Summarise open commitments; assess responsiveness, reliability, and risk. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per active supplier. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply, Procure Materials, Supplier Collaboration Health Assessment (SE-S-052). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous assessment state (via Assessment Change Events). |
| **Superseded By** | A newer assessment for the same supplier. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | At any moment, an active supplier has exactly one current Supplier Commitment Assessment. The assessment is derived from the current set of Supplier Commitments and the latest available reliability data. Assessment Change Events are immutable. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the assessment as the authoritative interpretation of the supplier’s commitment posture. |
| **Known Limitations** | The assessment is a point-in-time interpretation. |
| **Version Expectations** | Continuously maintained; not versioned. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated upon Supplier Commitment changes or reliability data updates. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Plan Supply, Procure Materials, Supplier Collaboration Health Assessment. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| Active | Supplier is actively assessed. | AB-S-041 (Update) |
| Archived | Supplier is no longer active for planning. | Archive operation |

- **Terminal States:** Archived.
- **History Preservation:** All assessment states and Assessment Change Events are retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Category | Information | Type | Description |
|----------|-------------|------|-------------|
| Identity | Supplier (SE-C-004) | Mandatory | The supplier being assessed. |
| Commitment Summary | Total Open Commitments, Committed vs Proposed, Late Commitments, Commitment Confidence Distribution | Derived | Aggregate view of the supplier’s commitment posture. |
| Responsiveness | Average Time to Acknowledge, Average Time to Commit, Response Rate | Derived | How quickly and reliably the supplier responds. |
| Reliability | Historical Commitment Accuracy, Current Confidence Trend | Derived | How reliable the supplier’s commitments have proven. |
| Risk Signals | Supply Continuity Risk, Commitment Risk, Dependency Risk, Concentration Risk | Derived | Current risk interpretation. |
| Traceability | Source Supplier Commitment IDs, Assessment Timestamp | Mandatory | Evidence lineage. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| assesses | Supplier (SE-C-004) | One-to-One | The supplier being assessed. |
| derived from commitments | Supplier Commitment (SE-S-050) | One-to-Many | Source commitments. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Semantic Dependency | Supplier (SE-C-004). |
| Supply Domain Dependency | Supplier Commitment (SE-S-050). |

**Invariants**
- At any moment, an active supplier has exactly one current Supplier Commitment Assessment.
- Assessment Change Events are immutable.

**Traceability**
- **Business Owner:** CA-S-005.
- **Produced By:** AB-S-041.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-051.
- **Governed By:** BR-S-086–089 and PO-S-060.
- **Upward:** Constitution CN-003, CN-004; ARS §3, §4, §16.

#### SE-S-041 – Capacity Health Assessment

**Business Intent**
Provide a periodic, authoritative management view of capacity health, stability, and volatility across a defined scope, enabling investment decisions, operational improvement identification, and trend analysis.

**Enterprise Meaning**
The Capacity Health Assessment is the aggregate root that maintains the published capacity health assessment version series for an assessment scope and evaluation period. Each version contains utilization summaries, constraint analyses, bottleneck impacts, stability and volatility metrics, risk summaries, capacity investment and operational improvement signals, and evidence references. It provides the enterprise’s periodic, governed statement of capacity health for management oversight, investment planning, and operational improvement, not an operational monitoring tool.

**Identity**
Assessment Scope + Evaluation Period. Each assessment version receives a globally unique Assessment Version Identifier and a monotonically increasing Version Number within the aggregate.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Manage Capacity (CA-S-004) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The periodic, versioned capacity health assessment for a defined scope and period. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Publish authoritative capacity health classifications, stability and volatility metrics, constraint analyses, risk summaries, and investment/improvement signals. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per Assessment Scope and Evaluation Period. Exactly one Published version is authoritative for the scope and period. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Evaluate Supply Quality (capacity effectiveness trends), Learn From Supply (constraint pattern learning), Management (dashboards). |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |
| **Supersedes** | The previous Published version for the same scope and period. |
| **Superseded By** | A newer Published version for the same scope and period. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | Exactly one Published Capacity Health Assessment exists for a given scope and evaluation period. A Published assessment is immutable. Every assessment references the Capacity Position Assessments used as evidence. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the assessment as the authoritative management view of capacity health for the period. It is a periodic snapshot, not a continuously updated operational view. |
| **Known Limitations** | The assessment is a point-in-time snapshot based on the best available evidence at the time of publication. It does not replace the underlying operational resource data. |
| **Version Expectations** | Published on a governed schedule. Previous versions are superseded and retained permanently for trend analysis. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Published on the cadence defined by the Capacity Management Policy (PO-S-050). |
| **Intended Consumers** | Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply, Management. |
| **Non-Intended Consumers** | None. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

**Version Lifecycle**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger | Responsible Behaviour |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|----------------------|
| Draft | Assessment computed for the evaluation period. Utilization summary, stability/volatility, constraint analysis, risk summary, and investment/improvement signals populated. | AB-S-031 (Publish Capacity Health Assessment) | AB-S-031 |
| Published | Assessment version released as authoritative for the scope and period. | Publication | AB-S-031 |
| Superseded | Version replaced by a newer Published version. | Newer version Published | AB-S-031 (on the previous version) |

- **Terminal States:** Superseded (retained permanently; no further state changes).
- **History Preservation:** All published assessments retained permanently.

**Information Model**

| Category | Information | Description |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| Identity | Assessment Scope, Evaluation Period, Assessment Version Identifier, Version Number | Unique version identity within the aggregate. |
| Utilization Summary | Average utilization, peak utilization, underutilized resource count, overloaded resource count | Aggregated utilization metrics for the scope. |
| Stability & Volatility | Capacity Stability (frequency of state changes), Capacity Volatility (amplitude of utilization swings) | Management metrics for capacity predictability. |
| Constraint Analysis | Binding constraints, bottleneck resources, throughput impact | Enterprise understanding of constraints limiting supply output. |
| Risk Summary | Overload risk exposure, underload cost exposure, bottleneck impact | Aggregated risk interpretation for management oversight. |
| Investment & Improvement Signals | Chronic overload resources, chronic underutilized resources, recurring bottlenecks, unstable utilization patterns, load balancing opportunities, routing optimization opportunities, flexibility improvement opportunities, expansion/contraction candidates | Forward-looking signals for capacity planning and operational improvement. |
| Evidence | Source Capacity Position Assessment IDs | Evidence used to produce the assessment. |
| Traceability | Publication Time, Superseded Version ID | Timestamps and version lineage. |

**Relationships**

| Relationship | Target Object | Cardinality | Description |
|--------------|---------------|-------------|-------------|
| evaluates health for scope | Assessment Scope (defined by domain) | Many-to-One | The set of resources evaluated. |
| references position assessments | Capacity Position Assessment (SE-S-040) | One-to-Many | Source assessments for current capacity positions. |

**Dependencies**

| Dependency Type | Description |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Supply Domain Dependency | Capacity Position Assessment (SE-S-040). |

**Invariants**
- Exactly one Published Capacity Health Assessment exists for a given scope and evaluation period.
- A Published Health Assessment is immutable.
- Every assessment references the Capacity Position Assessments used as evidence.

**Traceability**
- **Business Owner:** CA-S-004.
- **Produced By:** AB-S-031.
- **Referenced By:** FS-S-031.
- **Governed By:** BR-S-066–068 and PO-S-050.
- **Upward:** Constitution CN-003, CN-004; ARS §3, §4, §16.

#### AB-S-031 — Publish Capacity Health Assessment

**Purpose**
Compute capacity health classifications, stability/volatility metrics, and investment/improvement signals for all covered resources and publish the periodic, versioned assessment.

**Business Intent**
Provide the authoritative periodic management view of capacity health, enabling investment decisions and operational improvement identification.

**Trigger**
Scheduled per Capacity Management Policy (PO-S-050). May also be triggered on demand for governance review.

**Preconditions**
Latest Capacity Position Assessments (SE-S-040) are available for all resources in the assessment scope.

**Semantic Preconditions**
- Capacity Position Assessments (SE-S-040) are current for all Physical Resources (SE-C-007) in the defined scope.

**Business Behaviour**
For the assessment scope, compute utilization summaries, stability and volatility metrics, constraint analysis (binding constraints, bottleneck resources, throughput impact), risk summaries, and investment/improvement signals (chronic overload, chronic underutilization, recurring bottlenecks, flexibility opportunities). Compose the assessment version and publish.

**State Transitions**
- **Required Input State:** None (creation) or Draft.
- **Produced Output State:** Published (previous Published version for the same scope and period → Superseded).

**Business Transaction**
Protects Capacity Health Assessment aggregate. Atomic publication and previous version superseding.

**Decisions Invoked**
DE-S-032 (Classify Capacity Health).

**Rules Enforced**
BR-S-066 (Health Classification Thresholds), BR-S-067 (Stability and Volatility Thresholds), BR-S-068 (Investment and Improvement Signal Criteria).

**Policies Referenced**
PO-S-050 (Capacity Management Policy).

**Algorithms Invoked**
BA-S-011 (Classify Capacity Health — deferred).

**Events Published**
EV-S-031 (Capacity Health Assessment Published).

**Notifications Produced**
BN-S-031 (Capacity Health Assessment Published).

**Idempotency**
Re-assessment for the same scope and evaluation period produces the same results.

**Concurrency**
Assessments for different scopes are independent.

**Exceptional Conditions**
If source Capacity Position Assessments are missing for any resource, that resource is flagged as “Unassessed” with a reason code, and the assessment proceeds with the available data.

**Postconditions**
A Published Capacity Health Assessment exists for the scope and period. BN-S-031 published. The assessment is available for management oversight, investment planning, and trend analysis.

**Traceability**
Owned by SE-S-041. Invoked by FS-S-031. Publishes BN-S-031.

#### SE-S-060 – Procurement Recommendation


**Business Intent:** Maintain the enterprise’s continuously current sourcing decision for each procurement requirement—recording which suppliers to use, in what quantities, at what times, with what confidence, and under what rationale, assumptions, and decision evidence.

**Enterprise Meaning:** *(combined from original)*  
The Procurement Recommendation is the aggregate root that maintains the current procurement recommendation for one procurement requirement. It captures the requirement itself, the sourcing decision (supplier allocation, quantities, order timing), procurement feasibility, the decision rationale and evidence, confidence factors, and planning assumptions. Multiple sourcing strategies are natively supported.

**Identity:** Supply Plan Procurement Requirement Reference + Version.

**Authority Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Owner** | Procure Materials (CA-S-006) |
| **Authoritative Representation** | The current, governed sourcing decision for a procurement requirement. |
| **Business Responsibility** | Maintain the sourcing decision, rationale, evidence, and confidence. |
| **Authority Scope** | Per procurement requirement. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procurement Plan (SE-S-061), Explain Supply Decisions, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |

**Consumer Specification Contract**

| Section | Value |
|---------|-------|
| **Business Guarantees** | At any moment, exactly one Active Procurement Recommendation exists for each procurement requirement. Versions are immutable once superseded or archived. Decision evidence references specific artifacts. |
| **Required Interpretation** | Consumers shall treat the recommendation as the authoritative sourcing decision. It does not constitute a purchase order. |
| **Known Limitations** | Does not create purchase orders or transmit them to suppliers. |
| **Version Expectations** | Active → Superseded (when materially revised) → Archived. |
| **Freshness Expectations** | Updated when the Supply Plan, supplier commitments, or assessments change materially. |
| **Intended Consumers** | Procurement Plan, Explain Supply Decisions, Evaluate Supply Quality, Learn From Supply. |

**Lifecycle Specification Contract**

| State | Description | Transition Trigger |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| Active | Current authoritative recommendation. | AB-S-050 |
| Superseded | Replaced by a materially revised recommendation. | Material change |
| Archived | Requirement no longer active. | Archive operation |

| Confidence | Overall Recommendation Confidence, Supplier Confidence, Demand Confidence, Capacity Confidence, Inventory Risk Factor, Sourcing Complexity Factor | Derived | Multi-dimensional confidence. |
| Assumptions | Supplier lead time accuracy, demand forecast stability, capacity availability, transit time assumptions | Optional | Planning assumptions. |
| Alternative Recommendations | Alternative Recommendation(s) with ranking, rationale, and confidence | Optional | Future AI-generated options. |
